power.scope: whole-device fuel gauge. This is NOT power attributable to this app -- it includes display, radio and idle system load. Only the idle->load DELTA is meaningful for inference cost.

idle.note: whole-device fuel-gauge reading; subtract the idle baseline to attribute load. Sign convention of CURRENT_NOW varies by vendor, so the magnitude is used.

load.note: whole-device fuel-gauge reading; subtract the idle baseline to attribute load. Sign convention of CURRENT_NOW varies by vendor, so the magnitude is used.

power.caveats: Fuel gauges quantise coarsely (50-100 mA steps are common) and update on the order of seconds, so quote the median current and treat short windows as unreliable. The device must be unplugged; a charging reading is meaningless and is flagged.

methodology.headline: end-to-end only; pre/infer/post recorded for diagnosis
methodology.ordering: engine order rotated every round to spread thermal drift
methodology.coldStart: round 0 reported but excluded from dropFirst* figures
methodology.thermal: each round waits until the SoC reports at most LIGHT throttling; see the thermal array for the per-round status
